Task: Research STR ordinances in your county and municipality
Why: Ordinances vary by county and can prohibit STR outright or require permits before you close on a property

Task: Verify HOA rules and deed restrictions allow STR
Why: HOA or deed restrictions can override county permitting — check before you buy

Task: Form an LLC for the property
Why: Protects personal assets from guest liability claims — each property ideally in its own LLC

Task: Get an EIN from IRS.gov
Why: Required to open a business bank account and file taxes — free and takes 5 minutes online

Task: Open a dedicated business bank account
Why: Commingling personal and business funds can pierce your LLC liability protection

Task: Get a business credit card
Why: Keeps all STR expenses separate and trackable for tax purposes

Task: Set up bookkeeping software
Why: STR income and expenses need to be tracked from day one — not retroactively

Task: Consult a CPA familiar with STR tax rules
Why: Short-term rentals have unique tax treatment — depreciation bonus deductions and the 14-day rule matter

Task: Confirm the property is in a legal STR zone
Why: Zoning can allow residential use but prohibit commercial rental activity

Task: Pull the county permit requirements for STR
Why: Some counties require a business license or STR-specific permit before first guest

Task: Schedule any required county inspections
Why: Smoke detector placement and type are commonly regulated — Fannin County has specific requirements

Task: Hire a home designer for guest-oriented layout
Why: Designing for guests is different from designing for owners — flow

Task: Take a full property inventory before first guest
Why: Documents existing condition of the property and its contents for insurance and damage claims

Task: Install high-speed WiFi with a dedicated guest network
Why: Guests consider WiFi a utility — slow or unreliable WiFi is a top review complaint

Task: Install a smart lock with keypad or app-based entry
Why: Eliminates physical key handoff and lets you change codes between guests remotely

Task: Install exterior security cameras (Ring or equivalent)
Why: Deters damage and theft — interior cameras are prohibited on all platforms

Task: Install smoke detectors per county requirements
Why: Required by county ordinance in most jurisdictions — confirm type and placement before listing

Task: Install carbon monoxide detectors
Why: Required by Airbnb and VRBO — required by law in most states if property has gas or attached garage

Task: Install fire extinguishers in kitchen and common areas
Why: Required by most platforms — document location in your house manual

Task: Stock kitchen with guest-ready essentials
Why: Cookware
column10: basics — guests expect a functional kitchen

Task: Stock bathrooms with starter supplies
Why: Soap
column9: towels — enough for the first night minimum

Task: Purchase quality linens and bedding
Why: Bedding is one of the top drivers of 5-star reviews — do not cut corners here

Task: Set up turnover cleaning kit and process
Why: Your cleaner needs the right supplies and a consistent process — build it before the first checkout

Task: Install outdoor lighting for safety and ambiance
Why: Dark entry areas are a safety issue and a guest experience issue

Task: Set up outdoor seating and fire pit if applicable
Why: Outdoor living space is a top amenity search filter on Airbnb — document it in your listing

Task: Find and vet a reliable turnover cleaner
Why: Your cleaner is your most important vendor — a bad turnover costs you reviews

Task: Find and vet a handyman for quick repairs
Why: Mountain properties need someone who can respond fast when something breaks before a check-in

Task: Find and vet a licensed electrician
Why: Required for permit inspections and any electrical work the county requires

Task: Find and vet a licensed plumber
Why: Water issues in a rental property need a fast reliable response

Task: Find and vet an HVAC technician
Why: Mountain winters and summer heat — guests will leave bad reviews over HVAC failures

Task: Find and vet a landscaper
Why: Curb appeal matters for listing photos and first impressions on arrival day

Task: Find and vet a pest control service
Why: Mountain cabins need preventive pest treatment — ants and rodents are common

Task: Find and vet a septic service for pump and maintenance
Why: Know your pump schedule before you have a problem during a guest stay

Task: Create an Airbnb host account
Why: Largest short-term rental platform by volume — required for most STR markets

Task: Create a VRBO host account
Why: Second largest platform — different guest demographic often skews older and books longer stays

Task: Create a Houfy account for direct bookings
Why: Fee-free direct booking platform — use it to save guests the Airbnb service fee on repeat stays

Task: Set up payment processing for direct bookings
Why: Stripe or Square — needed to accept direct bookings off-platform

Task: Hire a professional photographer
Why: Listing photos are your most important marketing asset — phone photos cost you bookings

Task: Write a keyword-rich listing title
Why: Title drives search visibility — include property name and top 3-4 guest-relevant features

Task: Write your full listing description
Why: Cover what makes the property unique — be specific about location amenities and access

Task: Set all amenities accurately in the platform
Why: Airbnb and VRBO surface listings based on amenity filters guests apply — missing amenities = missed bookings

Task: Write clear house rules
Why: Set expectations before booking — guest screening starts with rules that discourage bad fits

Task: Set your base nightly rate and cleaning fee
Why: Research comparable properties on AirDNA before setting — do not guess on pricing

Task: Set pet fee if allowing dogs
Why: Dog-friendly is a premium filter on both platforms — charge appropriately for the wear

Task: Set minimum night requirements by day of week
Why: Minimum nights protect you from unprofitable short gaps — match to your market booking patterns

Task: Set check-in and check-out times
Why: Build enough turnover buffer for your cleaner — back-to-back same-day turnovers are high risk

Task: Set your cancellation policy
Why: Strict cancellation policies reduce last-minute cancellations but can suppress bookings — know the tradeoff

Task: Set up rule sets for lead time and minimum nights
Why: Different lead times require different minimums — last-minute bookings and far-out bookings behave differently

Task: Set up seasonal pricing
Why: Peak season and shoulder season should have different base rates

Task: Set up holiday pricing and blocking
Why: Apple Festival weekends and holiday weekends need special handling — decide now not in the moment

Task: Sync calendars between platforms with iCal
Why: Unsynchronized calendars cause double bookings — a serious platform violation on both Airbnb and VRBO

Task: Write your instant booking welcome message
Why: First impression after booking — confirm details and set expectations immediately

Task: Write your pre-arrival message (48 hours before)
Why: Send check-in instructions and a reminder of house rules before they leave home

Task: Write your check-in day message
Why: Confirm arrival and give them a contact number for any issues

Task: Write your mid-stay check-in message
Why: A brief check-in at day 2-3 catches problems before they become reviews

Task: Write your check-out reminder message
Why: Remind guests of check-out time and any specific instructions the night before

Task: Write your post-stay review request message
Why: Ask for the review promptly — review rate drops significantly after 48 hours

Task: Enable ID verification requirement on Airbnb
Why: Reduces party risk and gives you a paper trail if damage occurs

Task: Set a minimum reviews requirement where possible
Why: New accounts with no reviews are higher risk — balance this against filling your calendar early on

Task: Define your guest count verification policy
Why: Know your process for handling guests who arrive with more people than booked

Task: List your property on a regional STR platform
Why: Regional platforms attract guests who are already searching your specific area and ready to book

Task: Create a Facebook Business Page for your property
Why: Required to run paid ads and builds a long-term organic following

Task: Install Meta Pixel on your website
Why: Enables retargeting of website visitors — your most qualified ad audience

Task: Launch your first cold Facebook ad campaign
Why: Target your proven booking states — GA and FL first for North Georgia mountain properties

Task: Order or design branded signage for the property
Why: Window decals and yard signs drive direct booking awareness from guests already on property

Task: Design and order business cards for vendors and repeat guests
Why: Simple direct booking card with your website and contact — leave in the cabin and hand to cleaners

Task: Set up a Printify store for branded merchandise
Why: Guests who loved the stay will buy branded merch — passive revenue with no inventory

Task: Create a cabin items page with affiliate links
Why: Guests always ask what products you use — an affiliate page turns that into income

Task: Apply for Amazon Associates
Why: Required before you can earn commissions on product links — approval takes 1-3 days

Task: Build your curated guest items page
Why: Link every product in your cabin — soap shampoo coffee maker pillows outdoor gear everything

Task: Set up Google Analytics 4 on your website
Why: Tracks who is visiting your site where they came from and what they do before booking

Task: Set up Google Tag Manager
Why: Manages all tracking tags from one place without touching code for every change

Task: Submit your site to Google Search Console
Why: Tells you what search terms are bringing guests to your site and flags any indexing issues

Task: Build a Looker Studio performance dashboard
Why: Connects GA4 bookings and channel data in one place so you can see what is actually working

Task: Review AirDNA data monthly for pricing adjustments
Why: Your market changes seasonally — static pricing leaves money on the table
